content: On reception of the UDS Service InputOutputControlByIdentifier (0x2F), the Dcm module shall check if the DID can be control in the current mode condition (see configuration parameter DcmDspDidControlModeRuleRef ). If not, the Dcm module shall send the calculated negative response code of the referenced DcmModeRule .
